# SCCE IAC Validation Demo

## Setup

```
# Login to your GCP environment and paste the authorization link generated by this command:
gcloud auth login --no-launch-browser

# Export environment variables
export GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT='your-project-id'
export GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION='us-central1'  # Optional
export GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS='/home/you/.config/gcloud/legacy_credentials/<your-user>@<your-domain.com>/adc.json'

```

Install terraform if you don't have it already. 

https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/install



## Demo

1. Review resources in main.tf
1. Review commands in scc-report-cmd.sh
1. Run scc-report-cmd.sh and review output
